chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Dawud ibn Sirhan, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) initiated me without my asking him, so he said: 'The Itikaf is for three days, meaning the Sunnah, if Allah wills.'

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.الِاعْتِكَافُ: Itikaf (seclusion in the mosque for worship)

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum number of days for Sunnah Itikaf according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) proactively establishes three days as the minimum duration for the Sunnah practice of Itikaf, highlighting the significance of this ritual seclusion in the mosque. The Imam’s initiative in stating the ruling without a direct question underscores its foundational role in Shia jurisprudence and the spiritual discipline of withdrawing from worldly affairs for worship.
